## Dispatch order · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T03:40Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26347, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26347" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`), and the audit it comes from (#26184 comment 6425678185, Part A, § objectstack-automation); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26347` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26347 --file=F` (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade on this card: comment 6429233848 (triage seat, 2026-10-26 22:52Z) — **p1**, `domain:skills`, `area:workflow`, Tier H (`skills/**` is a published surface), blocked on #26304; unlocked at comment 6431102318 (01:01Z): #26304 closed `completed` with PR #26355 (`4548ba34e6`), the key landed as `type: 'record_link'` (`SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_TYPE`, `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`), 「read the merged refusals from that file before writing the skill line, not from this body」. The card was filed by seat `domain:ui#1` on behalf of the #26304 thread as the skills + eval half triage 6427137154 allowed; its 「What is owed」 section is the whole scope: teach exactly that, nothing wider. Maintainer's standing rulings that bind this PR: ruling A on the token ceilings (below) and 「卡线程用天花板档」 (your tier).

### Scope and tier

File surface: `skills/objectstack-automation/**` — `SKILL.md` (the node table's `screen` row at L91 lists `config.fields[]` and its field shapes; the `record_link` teaching goes where an AI author writing a screen flow's result screen will read it: that row, or a short `references/examples-flows.md` fragment if the row cannot hold it — pick one home, not two) plus the package's `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` (the card's eval prompt, verbatim, as a new entry in the file's existing shape); `references/_index.md` only if a generator owns it (read `package.json` scripts) **+ the touched rows of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** under the maintainer's ruling A (his tap 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 on the seat thread's decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, 2026-10-27 01:21Z; option A verbatim: 「八张卡的 PR 各自削重复后,把所改文件的天花板行提高恰好差额,正文引用你这句;教学和 eval 都落。」): first cut GENUINE restatements inside the files you touch (each cut must have a surviving home in the same file, named in the PR body), then raise each touched row by exactly the measured remainder — ceil(utf8 bytes / 4), `SKILL.md` minus its 20-byte version line — pinned AT the measurement (headroom 0), the tap quoted verbatim and untranslated in each row comment and in the PR body. ⛔ Not line 1 of `SKILL.md` (PR #25640 owns the version stamp). ⛔ No other package's rows. Tier H: the PR stays a draft; you never ready, arm, enqueue or approve it (os-dev.md rule 2); if a governed approver does, report it, touch nothing.

`os-dev.md` 290–291 bind: the PR body reports TWO readings, the whole-file before/after line count of every changed `.md` file and the whole-package before/after (the sum over `SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`), and the default is to REFUSE a small feature written large: teach `record_link` in the fewest lines an AI author needs (the shape, the two required keys, the refused keys, the one example), pay additions inside the package where a genuine duplicate exists, and raise the ceiling only by the measured remainder.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at `9a0108cd` (seat, 2026-10-27 03:37Z): **holds.**
1. 0 hits for `record_link` in `skills/objectstack-automation/**`; `SKILL.md` L91 is the `screen` node row (`config.fields[]: { … }`), L48 the `screen` flow kind, L410 the screen-flow file table; `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` and `references/examples-flows.md` carry no screen-field shapes. The card's 「Teach」 paragraph is the content; confirm each clause against the schema before writing it.
2. Spec, `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts` L810–853 on `origin/main`: `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_TYPE = 'record_link'` (named `record_link`, not `record`, because a screen field's `type` borrows the object field-type vocabulary where `record` already means something); `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_REFERENCE_REQUIRED` (must declare `reference`, the object the record belongs to); `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_DEFAULT_VALUE_REQUIRED` (must declare `defaultValue`, the id of the record it shows, usually a CEL value envelope over a flow variable — the spec's own example is `defaultValue: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account_id' }`; the card's is `'account.id'` over a `create_record` node's `outputVariable` — read `screen-field-record-link.test.ts` and PR #26355's tests for which spelling the resume actually resolves, and teach THAT); `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_REFUSED_KEYS = ['required', 'options', 'placeholder', 'min', 'max']` with `screenFieldRecordLinkRefusedKey(key)` (shows a record, takes no input, the run refuses any value submitted under its name — `validateScreenInputs`, `400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`); `judgeHeadlessScreen` never counts it as answered. Teach the `lookup` contrast in one clause if the row already teaches `lookup` (an input picker over `reference`).
3. Ratchet rows, measured on `origin/main`: `SKILL.md` 24034 B − 20 → 6004 = ceiling 6004 (headroom 0); `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` 7289 B → 1823 = ceiling 1823 (headroom 0); `references/examples-flows.md` ceiling 1436 (measure it if you touch it). Every byte you add is paid by a genuine cut or by a ruling-A raise — no silent headroom.
4. Eval: the card gives prompt, expected_output and assertions verbatim (`must_contain` `record_link`, `reference`, `defaultValue`, `outputVariable`, `dialect: 'cel'`; `must_not_contain` `type: 'record'`, `](`). Write the ideal answer so that it does NOT itself contain a `must_not_contain` string (the sibling wave's exemplars tripped their own negated assertions — do not write 「not `type: 'record'`」 inside expected_output; say 「never the object field type」 instead).
5. `Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ no `Skills-docs:` line is owed (SKILL.md:313 since `b33dd25b`); write it only if true.

### Card-specific clauses

- Every new teaching gets an eval prompt in `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` in the file's existing shape (ids sequential); `pnpm check:skill-docs`, `pnpm check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:skill-examples` green (read `package.json` for the exact script names; if a name differs, run the one that exists and say so); if you mark the example block `os:check`, it must type-check against the built spec.
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26347` (the harness writes its attribution comment above it — os-dev.md's exemption; `Fixes` is then the first line you write), then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial (the skill teaches a key the protocol already carries), then the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的 — Tier H, so 需要你做的 names the one action: approve, or 「Merge when ready」), then What changes / the two readings table / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification. ⛔ No model name anywhere in the commit or PR; the model-free trailer pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26347`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- Serial: #26362 (the approval-lock read) is the NEXT card on this same package and waits for this PR to land — do not teach it here. No open PR touches `skills/objectstack-automation/**` (scan at 03:37Z; #26390 landed at 03:18Z as `96f12585`, so base on `origin/main` ≥ `9a0108cd` and the automation rows you see are current). Siblings #26407 / #26416 / #26420 edit other packages' rows of the ratchet script; if the queue kicks your PR on a row conflict, merge `origin/main` (merge commit, no rebase, no force), keep main's sibling rows, re-run the ratchet gate, push, and post a follow-up report.
- ⛔ GitHub MCP tools: none, reads included (REST via curl with the bearer token from the environment, never printed; writes only through the relay as above). ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26347 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations`, `line_budget` (per `.md` file before/after and the package total before/after) and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, the head sha, the report comment id and the premise verdict; then stay subscribed to the PR for the contract review's verdict and a possible patch round.
